reviews.review: Excellent game to play with friends and relax

I suggest the game to alien fans when it is on deep discount but no one else. 

Pros: It is Alien, Story seems okay. Graphics are just okay but they fit the theme.  the audio of the weapons are awesome.  The idea of playing it with a team sounds great.  the interfaces is pretty cool like futuristic retro.

Cons:  controls feel horrible.  they are not really  but they feel that they are. When you cannot find a team you play with bots and it is horrible.  It is a single player campaign with no REAL single player option.  The cover option is a cool gimmick but provides little use.  There is no jump in the game.  It is more frustrating than fun.  The dialog scenes they didn't even try. mouths don't move and the models just seem to do an idle dance.  Lifeless shells.  the aliens you battle just.. weird... I'm not big on Alien lore, maybe it fits but for someone like me who watched the original movies mostly.. just.. seems off putting.

Maybe it gets better later in the game i doubt i made it half of the way through before I decided to stop and quit punishing myself.  Maybe it is much better on console. 

I am grateful i didn't buy the whole pack and just the base game.  Find it on sale, try it out if you have a couple friends to play with.  if not just watch a lets play on youtube to get the story.
Nice left 4 dead clone to have mindless fun with friends, don't play it solo

As a big fan of the franchise, as well as games like WWZ, this was a wonderful experience. 
Be it killing swarms of space puppies in the campaign, or trying to survive unending waves of new types, its all fun and never dulls.
PROS:
-Beautiful graphics (Capturing that "Alien" feel of the movies)
-The upgrades aren't lacking, progress feels like progress and each build serves its purpose
-Creative designs (New alien types really stick out)

CONS:
-Campaign felt too easy at times. Even in the harder difficulties
-Exploits galore
